page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-48 is a general-purpose virtual machine offering 48 vCPUs and 192 GB of memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Compute is powered by dedicated 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon x86_64 processors configured across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. The processor architecture includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB shared L3 cache, backed by instruction set extensions such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, and FMA for vectorized and cryptographic execution.

Hardware capabilities do not include local storage or dedicated graphics accelerators, meaning all persistent storage must be mounted remotely via network-attached block devices. Synthetic and system benchmarks position this instance in the middle tier for compute density. The server achieves a PassMark memory score of 2,767.58, ranking in the top 25 percent of tested systems, with uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaching 186.37 GB/sec and write bandwidth reaching 78.33 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core processing demonstrates lower relative throughput, evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1,410.68 and moderate per-core Geekbench metrics.

The 48-thread parallelism enables consistent throughput across concurrent enterprise operations, generating 37.18 million Redis SET operations per second, 24.87 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and a Geekbench clang compilation score of 30,141.0. While LLM prompt evaluation on smaller models yields standard rates, autoregressive text generation and large-model inference remain slow due to the absence of discrete GPU acceleration.

Given its high core count, memory bandwidth, and lack of bundled local NVMe storage, n2-standard-48 represents a balanced resource allocation for multi-threaded enterprise workloads. It is well matched for medium-to-large relational databases, distributed caching clusters, build and CI/CD pipelines, and scale-out web serving fleets that rely on robust multi-core scheduling rather than extreme single-thread frequency.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-48 is a general-purpose instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 192 GB of RAM on dedicated 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon x86_64 processors with 24 physical cores. Built on a standard 1:4 processor-to-memory ratio, the configuration features AVX-512 vector extensions and 33 MB of L3 cache, without integrated local storage or discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight strong memory subsystem throughput, reaching the top quartile in PassMark memory testing alongside 186.37 GB/sec large-block read bandwidth. Multi-core performance is balanced across parallel tasks, yielding 37.18 million Redis SET operations per second and 24.87 GB/sec web serving throughput, though single-thread metrics and large LLM generation speeds show limitations. The instance is suited for multi-threaded backend services, enterprise databases, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and memory-backed caching layers requiring reliable multi-core compute.
